newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S NORTH-WEST CO-OP TENDERS 34,650 T MAIZE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S NORTH-WEST CO-OP TENDERS 34,650 T MAIZE.

text.p: South Africa's North-West Co-operative Ltd said on Tuesday it would offer for export 34,650 tonnes of yellow maize grade YM1 with an option to deliver up to 20 percent of YM2 grade.
Tenders close at 1000 GMT on August 15 and the successful tenderer would be notified of acceptance of the bid on or before 1400 GMT on August 15.
It said it was a condition that the maize had to be exported on or before December 31.
The maize would be delivered on or before September 15 and payment had to be made not later than seven days after physical delivery or on September 15, which ever date was the earliest.
